text:
alejandra: Quick sync — we need a clear staging->GA checkpoint that owners can sign off on by EOD Friday. I sketched a minimal checklist below.
sam: share the checklist pls.
ajlejandra: posting quick bullets: 1) SLA numbers agreed, 2) docs draft up, 3) oncall + runbooks, 4) monitoring alerts + dashboards, 5) pricing/quota mapping, 6) private/dedicated contract clauses, 7) rollout plan + fallbacks.
sam: prefer we call out region failover (dual-region) as a separate line — customers ask about cross-region drift.
devon: +1. Also call out model-variant fallback (quantized fallback) in SLO doc. Important for graceful degradation.
jyoti: For SLA numbers — ops wants p95 inference latency target per model class and a data-plane uptime % (monthly). Proposal: p95 < 200ms for small models, < 400ms for large; uptime 99.9%.
alejandra: good starting point. Are those acceptable for GA?
lina: From commercial: 99.9% is fine for GA, but we need a failure compensation approach in pricing docs (credits). Ops wants to avoid open-ended SLAs.
ops-bot: reminder: previous GA threads required oncall rotation documented and 2 runbooks (deploy rollback + hotfix) linked.
sam: ok — action owners? I can own monitoring + grafana dashboards.
devon: I’ll own deployment fallbacks (region + model fallback) and write the procedure.
jyoti: I’ll own SLO wording and alert thresholds; need input from runtime team on exact latencies.
lina: I’ll draft commercial language re: credits and exceptions, will sync with legal.
alejandra: docs: I'll draft the end-to-end ops checklist and public customer-facing FAQ. Need a short snippet for internal roll-call: "Staging to GA Acceptance" with 5 signatories: PM, Eng lead, Infra, SRE, Legal.
sam: Can we include a lightweight smoke test that validates routing + fallback? Something like: run 100 requests with 2 regions flagged, verify <=5% fallback rate and <10% error rate.
devon: yes — I'll add a smoke script in repo: ./scripts/ga_smoke.sh and a CI job. Will post PR.
jyoti: For monitoring, add an automated regression alert that triggers if token cost/unit increases >15% vs baseline — to catch sudden perf regressions.
lina: Pricing note: we must map quotas to committed tiers for Dedicated customers; I'll include a migration guide.
alejandra: timeline check: owners sign off on drafts by Thursday EOD, legal review by Friday noon, final sign-off meeting Friday 4pm. Anyone blocked?
sam: blocked on runtime numbers for p95 — ping runtime team.
devon: blocked on a small env constraint for dual-region tests; infra is short on GPU in ap-south. Tagging infra later.
ops-bot: incident log: previous dedicated rollout had a 30-min region DNS flip; recommend we rehearse DNS failover in staging.
ajlejandra: noted. OK — I'll consolidate this thread into a one-pager and post in #shiproom. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
